faqs.question: How do I unlock a password-protected PDF?
faqs.answer: Upload your locked PDF document, enter the valid document password, and click Unlock PDF to download a decrypted version.

faqs.question: Can this tool crack unknown passwords?
faqs.answer: No. For security and ethical compliance, you must provide the correct password to decrypt and save the unlocked document.

faqs.question: Are my decrypted files kept private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Decryption happens entirely in your local browser memory. No document data is sent over the internet.
